title: “God, give me the courage to trust You when the road ahead is unknown. Teach me to listen, to release, and to follow with humility. Amen.”
paragraphs: “God, give me the courage to trust You when the road ahead is unknown. Teach me to listen, to release, and to follow with humility. Amen.”

When I read the Bible, it often feels like I am standing nearby, watching quietly.
I see Abraham pause at the edge of everything familiar. Home behind him. Promise ahead. God does not give him a map—only a call. The morning light feels gentle, but the step forward feels costly.

⏸️ Pause.
What kind of trust leaves without knowing the destination?

As I witness this moment, I feel the weight of letting go—and the strange peace that follows obedience. Maybe faith does not begin with certainty, but with willingness. What might God be inviting me to leave so I can begin again?
💭 Share what this moment stirs in you
What do you imagine Abraham felt as he turned away from his home?
Is there something familiar God may be asking you to release right now?
How do you respond when the path ahead is unclear but the call feels true?
What would trust look like for you in this season?
